papers.title: Lactate-associated H3K18la upregulates RNF166 to promote immune evasion in hepatocellular carcinoma by remodeling c-Jun ubiquitination.
papers.journal: Apoptosis : an international journal on programmed cell death
papers.summary: Lactate accumulation drives H3K18 lactylation at the RNF166 promoter, upregulating this E3 ubiquitin ligase in hepatocellular carcinoma. RNF166 stabilizes c-Jun via K63-linked ubiquitination at K50/K56, enhancing PD-L1 transcription and suppressing CD8+ T-cell infiltration; pharmacological c-Jun inhibition (T-5224) enhanced anti-PD-L1 antitumor efficacy.

papers.title: The analgesic effect and mechanism of celastrol in formalin-induced inflammatory pain mouse model.
papers.summary: Celastrol, a triterpenoid from Tripterygium wilfordii, reduced formalin-induced inflammatory pain in mice without affecting motor function. Antinociception required the kappa-opioid receptor: dynorphin and OPRK1 were upregulated, p-CaMKII/ERK/CREB signaling decreased, and dorsal horn c-Fos/GFAP activation fell; nor-binaltorphimine blocked all these effects.

papers.title: CircARHGAP10 inhibits colorectal cancer cell proliferation, migration and invasion by governing the miR-29a-5p/LPP axis and regulating Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway.
papers.summary: CircARHGAP10 is downregulated in colorectal cancer, and overexpression suppresses proliferation, migration, and invasion. Acting as a competing endogenous RNA, it sponges miR-29a-5p, restoring LPP expression, dampening Wnt/beta-catenin signaling, and reversing epithelial-mesenchymal transition. This circRNA-centered regulatory network offers a promising therapeutic target for colorectal cancer.

papers.title: Curcumin improves myocardial redox status in an experimental model of rheumatoid arthritis.
papers.summary: In adjuvant-induced rheumatoid arthritis rats, curcumin (200 mg/kg) reduced myocardial pro-oxidant levels and lipid peroxidation, increased superoxide dismutase activity, and restored reduced glutathione, especially combined with methotrexate. Histopathology showed protection of synovial and myocardial tissue, supporting curcumin as a cardioprotective antioxidant in rheumatoid arthritis.

papers.title: Wogonin alleviates inflammation caused by neutrophil extracellular traps in atopic dermatitis via miR-4667-5p/CCL2 pathway.
papers.summary: Wogonin, screened from Dictamni cortex constituents, alleviated atopic dermatitis inflammation by downregulating CCL2 in keratinocytes. miR-4667-5p directly targets CCL2 mRNA; overexpression suppressed CCL2 and neutrophil extracellular trap-driven inflammation, while a miR-4667-5p antagonist weakened wogonin's benefit, rescued by CCL2 silencing.

papers.title: Ellagic acid attenuates myocardial fibrosis by suppressing Bmi1-mediated inhibition of the p53/p21 pathway in cardiac fibroblasts.
papers.summary: Ellagic acid reduced isoproterenol-induced myocardial fibrosis in rats and inhibited TGF-beta-driven cardiac fibroblast proliferation, migration, and myofibroblast differentiation. Mechanistically, it reduced Bmi1 protein, relieving Bmi1-mediated p53 repression; p53/p21 activation caused G1/S arrest. The Bmi1 inhibitor PTC-209 recapitulated the anti-fibrotic effect.

papers.title: Regulatory roles of pyroptosis-associated lncRnas in breast cancer progression and immune microenvironment.
papers.summary: This review describes pyroptosis-associated lncRNA signatures stratifying breast cancer patients into prognostic risk groups. Low-risk tumors showed increased CD8+ T, NK, and B-cell infiltration with higher immune checkpoint expression; high-risk tumors displayed M2 macrophage enrichment and higher mutation burden. lncRNAs regulate pyroptosis via inflammasome activation and gasdermin signaling.

papers.title: Improved Genomic Resources for the swordtail cricket, Laupala kohalensis Otte 1994.
papers.summary: Researchers assembled a chromosome-level genome for the Hawaiian swordtail cricket Laupala kohalensis using PacBio HiFi plus RNA- and Iso-Seq: 99% of 47 scaffolds placed on eight chromosomes, 98.8% BUSCO score, ~268 Mb N50, 17,670 annotated genes, and a nuclear mitochondrial DNA segment on chromosome 7, enabling speciation genomics.

papers.title: The neuroprotective potential of thymoquinone and intermittent fasting on aluminum chloride-induced Alzheimer's disease like model in rat hippocampus: insights into neurogenesis and autophagy.
papers.summary: In aluminum chloride-induced Alzheimer's-like rats, thymoquinone and intermittent fasting each reduced oxidative stress, apoptosis, amyloid deposition, and p-tau, modulating microglial activation while supporting neurogenesis and autophagy (LC3B-II/p62). Effects were strongest combined; intermittent fasting alone outperformed thymoquinone, suggesting complementary neuroprotective mechanisms in hippocampus.

papers.title: Phytoextract-loaded bioinspired PLGA nanofibrous scaffold promotes diabetic wound healing via anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects in in vitro and in vivo experimental models.
papers.summary: Vitex negundo and Jatropha multifida phytoextracts loaded into PLGA-gelatin nanofibrous scaffolds (255-280 nm fibers, ~90% cumulative release over 168 hours) improved diabetic wound healing in rats: better closure by day 21, lowered TNF-alpha, IL-6, and oxidative stress markers, with complete re-epithelialization, fibroblast proliferation, and neovascularization histologically.

papers.title: Regulatory Evolution and the Genetic Basis of Human Brain Expansion.
papers.summary: This review synthesizes how conserved noncoding elements provide a stable regulatory framework while human accelerated regions and transposable-element-derived sequences introduce lineage-specific regulatory changes shaping primate brain development. CRISPR perturbation, reporter assays, and single-cell multi-omics link regulatory variation to neurodevelopmental phenotypes, cognition, and neurological disorder susceptibility.

papers.title: Design, Synthesis, Antimicrobial Evaluation, DFT Analysis, Molecular Docking and Molecular Dynamics Studies of Thiadiazol-Hydrazine Derivatives as Potential Dihydrofolate Reductase Inhibitors.
papers.summary: Thiadiazol-hydrazine derivatives (3a-3d) were synthesized and evaluated as antimicrobials and dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR) inhibitors. Compound 3b showed the best antibacterial profile against tested strains, favorable DHFR active-site docking with hydrogen-bond and hydrophobic interactions, persistent protein-ligand complexes in molecular dynamics, and characterized electronic properties by DFT calculations.
